Job Description :

• Analyze performance of marketing campaigns across all channels (digital, field activation, social, lifecycle communications), identifying drivers of success and areas for improvement.
• Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reporting frameworks covering key metrics such as acquisition, conversion, CAC, ROI, and channel effectiveness.
• Provide actionable insights on customer behavior, demand patterns, and market dynamics to support marketing and GTM strategy.
• Support optimization of marketing spend by identifying the most effective channels, campaigns, and approaches.
• Work closely with Digital Marketing and BTL teams to evaluate campaign performance and recommend improvements.
• Collaborate with Product, CVM, and Base Management teams to provide insights on customer acquisition, engagement, and monetization.
• Analyze competitor activity, pricing, and GTM strategies to support better positioning and tactical decisions.
• Support forecasting and planning by identifying trends, growth opportunities, and performance gaps.
• Develop and enhance data models, tracking mechanisms, and attribution frameworks to improve measurement accuracy.
• Ensure data integrity, consistency, and reliability across all marketing performance reporting.
• Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for stakeholders.

Requirements :

• S1 (Strata 1) degree in Data Analytics / Business Administration / Marketing is minimum requirements.
• Minimum 3-5 Years experience in Advertising and Marketing, Business & Management roles
• Strong Data Analytical and critical thinking skills.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)
